The Sumerian text describes a bleak afterlife ("House of Darkness," "dirt is their drink"), while the Egyptian text emphasizes moral truth and divine guidance without describing the afterlife. This contrast supports option (A).  

Option (B) is incorrect because neither text focuses on political obedience.  
Option (C) is unsupported because gender relations are not mentioned.  
Option (D) is incorrect because social hierarchy is not the focus of either text.  

Final answer: (A)
